verdict.rationale: Highnote documents an integrated ledger for tracking money movement and balances, with transactions posting the moment they occur rather than in end-of-day batches. Its docs also mention daily reconciliation, settlement, and reconciliation on the same core ledger as issuing. These are brief, marketing-level claims, though, and nothing shows the specific finance-lead workflow described in the story. Missing for 10: evidence of an authorization-to-clearing linked transaction ledger, settlement reports a subscriber can access and reconcile to the penny, detail on real-time card versus account balance views, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
